propagation_model.principle: Do not blanket-copy every primary modifier to every secondary skill; use the profile and semantic compatibility.

native_affix_inheritance.elements: expected: Burn/Cryo/Shock subscribe to newly registered skills
native_affix_inheritance.seeker: not automatic: Homing currently mutates the primary skill unless the secondary is intrinsically homing
native_affix_inheritance.bounce: not automatic: Bounce currently mutates the primary skill unless the secondary is intrinsically bouncing
native_affix_inheritance.pierce: not automatic: Pierce currently mutates the primary skill
native_affix_inheritance.fragmentation: binding-order dependent; explicit secondary-skill validation required
native_affix_inheritance.freewheel: primary-skill retrigger semantic; not treated as generic alt-fire duplication
